If quality and long-term durability are your top priorities, I would start with the Hybride Infinite®.

It is Tediber’s most advanced mattress, with 31 cm of height, 9 comfort layers, 7 support zones, and up to 1,700 pocket micro-springs. Its reinforced structure is designed to provide stable, precise support, while the breathable construction helps with heat regulation. It also offers two comfort sides, so you can adjust the feel.

If you want a strong balance between quality and price, the Hybride Premium is a very good alternative, with 27 cm, 8 comfort layers, and a reversible comfort topper.

turns.replyTail:
There is no subscription or automatic refill plan. The Hybride Infinite® is a one-time purchase.

It is designed to be repairable, so certain parts such as the cover or integrated comfort layer may be replaced over time instead of replacing the whole mattress. The integrated topper is not sold separately as a standalone product.

I still need your mattress size to give you the exact total for the recommendation.
